issues.claim: Federation Logistics runs food-grade, bonded and liquor-licensed warehousing ... (opening paragraph)
issues.problem: The word "food-grade" does not appear on fedlogistics.com; the homepage lists FDA, USDA and SQF certification and the Port Authority directory lists the commodity "Food Products". The fact is reasonably supported, but it is a two-step reading presented as a direct statement, and the source note attributes "food-grade scope" to the homepage.
issues.fix: Either write "FDA/USDA/SQF-certified warehousing" (which is what the site says) or attribute food-grade directly to the Port Authority directory, e.g. "...and a Port Authority directory listing food products".

issues.claim: Expected impact (section 1): "After hours a buyer finds no service page and no call button"
issues.problem: Two separate exposures are merged under one condition. The missing call button is caused by the 1439px CSS breakpoint and applies at every hour on phones and most tablets, not only after hours; the missing service page applies at every hour too.
issues.fix: Split them: "At any hour on a phone the header call button is hidden; out of hours there is also no service page to read and no form acknowledgement."

issues.claim: Sources line: Port Authority PDF cited simply as "0800-1700 hours"
issues.problem: The figure comes from the October 2023 edition of the Warehouse Directory, i.e. it is a three-year-old third-party listing, not a current published hour. Presented without the date it can read as current business hours.
issues.fix: Add "(Oct 2023 edition)" after the PDF, as the profile does.
